I have been working on a tabletop extreme ultraviolet laser system that can be used to study ultra fast magnetization dynamics in magnetic multilayer samples.
we are trying to understand the fundamental mechanisms of ultrafast magnetism and to control the ultrafast magnetization with extreme ultraviolet pulses.
we have been able to study ultrafast magnetization with extreme ultraviolet laser pulses and we have demonstrated the first ultrafast spin current driven magnetization enhancement.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can use extreme ultraviolet light to measure ultrafast magnetization changes with a time resolution of 50 fs.
we can use the transverse magnetro optical Kerr (TMOK) effect as an ultrafast probe of magnetic dynamics with extreme ultraviolet (EUV) light.
